create_identity_collator: create an identity collator that returns the input batch unchanged for VISSL data loading
register_collator_identity: register the identity_collator function with the VISSL collator registry under the name 'identity_collator'
get_collator_identity: get the identity collator from the VISSL collator registry by name 'identity_collator' with optional collate_params
test_identity_collator: test the identity_collator function to verify it returns the input batch without modification
run_identity_collator: run the identity_collator on a data batch to pass it through unchanged in a VISSL dataloader pipeline
